title: Modern House minutes from Broadway
description:
We would to welcome you to this
amazing and modern townhouse. 
The house is located very close to Nashville downtown, where you can enjoy the live music or an hockey game at the Bridgestone Arena. Broadway is located 8 minutes away 
Only 5 minutes away from Nissan Stadium where you can watch football games, concert and other amazing events.
Also very close from BNA airport. (15 minutes)

The space
In this house you will find two bedrooms equipped one with queen size bed and the other with a queen size bed bunk, and each room has its own private bathroom and balcony.
In the 2nd floor you will have access to a modern and  full equipped Kitchen. A living room with a Smart TV to enjoy your favorite shows on a sofa that can transform to a full size bed. And also you find an half-bath.
You will be able to safely park your car in the 2 car garage available.
